lines.trans: Hello, young student.
May I ask where Professor Fang has his office?
Over there — how about I take you over?
That would be wonderful, thank you!
Old Fang, are there any good ones in this batch of students?

words.gram: Meaning: to have or not have.

lines.trans: Xingtian wants to recruit an intern? Now that is something new!
His habit is never taking on interns.
I am different from him; I asked for one intern spot.
Working under me, it will definitely be on Twelve Singers.
